May 17, 1935. Afternoon Translation

The Shanghai Pao(上海报), a mosquito paper, published the following editorial on May 16 :-

THE INTERNATIONAL COURT OF ARBITRATION.

The Shanghai International Settlement Court Rendition Agreement will expire at the end of March, 1936. The Ministry of Justice is paying attention to the matter and is forming the Judicial Rights Research Committee which will be inaugurated shortly and which will study the problem of abolishing consular jurisdiction. However, some foreign residents in Shanghai have proposed the formation of an International Court of Arbitration to handle all law-suits concerning foreign residents.

Consular jurisdiction should not exist in an independent country, but it does exist in China to-day. Some years ago, China notified the Powers of her desire to abolish extraterritoriality. Although at that time the Powers sent their delegates to China to study the judicial administration to prepare for the abolition of extraterritoriality, so far the matter fails of solution.

The existence of consular jurisdiction not only impairs the integrity of the Chinese judicial administration, but affects the peace and order of China. China is naturally anxious to abolish the privilege, nevertheless the foreigners will refuse to give it up. The suggestion to form an International Court of Arbitration is not advocated by a few number of foreigners. About 80% or 90% of foreign residents are entertaining this absurd idea. Last month an editor of a Chinese newspaper owned by foreigners published in a conspicuous manner a report on the seduction of a boy by a certain foreigner for the purpose of arousing public attention, but on the following day the certain foreigner, after severely reprimanding the editor named Tsu(朱), instructed all other editors to exercise care in future when publishing articles relating to foreign residents in Shanghai. Recently the French Police refused to handle the case in which a Netherlands subject of the Isako Circus raped a 13-year old Chinese girl. No report on this case has appeared in foreign newspapers. One can judge the intentions of foreigners by these two incidents.

Foreigners enjoy extraterritoriality on the ground of the imperfectness of the Chinese law. They compelled China to acknowledge this unequal treaty by high-handed means. It is an undeniable fact that in the Ching Dynasty Chinese law was imperfect, but nowadays drastic reforms have been effected through efforts made by the Legislative Yuan. Therefore, the abolition of consular jurisdiction is nothing but natural.

Formerly extraterritoriality existed in Japan and Turkey but it has been abolished. The people of China should strive to effect the abolition of the right.

1935年5月17日。下午译文

小报《上海报》于5月16日刊登了以下社论：

国际仲裁法庭。

上海公共租界法院移交协定将于1936年3月底期满。司法部正关注此事，并正在组建司法权研究委员会，该委员会即将成立，并将研究废除领事裁判权的问题。然而，一些在上海的外国居民提议成立一个国际仲裁法庭，以处理涉及外国居民的所有诉讼案件。

在一个独立国家中，领事裁判权本不应存在，但今日在中国却依然存在。数年前，中国曾通知列强其废除治外法权的愿望。虽然当时列强派遣代表来华考察司法行政，为废除治外法权做准备，但至今此事仍未得到解决。

领事裁判权的存在不仅损害了中国司法行政的完整性，而且影响了中国的和平与秩序。中国自然渴望废除这一特权，然而外国人将拒绝放弃。提议成立国际仲裁法庭的并非少数外国人。约80%或90%的外国居民都抱有这种荒谬的想法。上月，一家由外国人拥有的中文报纸的编辑以显著方式刊登了一篇关于某外国人诱奸一名男孩的报道，旨在引起公众关注，但次日，该外国人在严厉斥责名为朱(音译)的编辑后，指示所有其他编辑今后在刊登有关上海外国居民的文章时要谨慎行事。最近，法国警察拒绝处理伊萨科马戏团(音译)的一名荷兰籍成员强奸一名13岁中国女孩的案件。外国报纸上没有出现关于此案的报道。人们可以通过这两起事件判断外国人的意图。

外国人以中国法律不完善为由享有治外法权。他们通过强硬手段迫使中国承认这一不平等条约。不可否认的事实是，在清朝时期，中国法律确实不完善，但如今通过立法院的努力，已经进行了彻底的改革。因此，废除领事裁判权是顺理成章之事。

以前日本和土耳其也存在治外法权，但已被废除。中国人民应努力争取废除这一权利。

ese courts in the International

据司法院副院长谭震(音译)先生昨日在接受记者采访时证实，有消息称司法部已组织一个特别委员会，为在国际租界中国法院移交于1925年3月底期满时，就废除上海领事裁判权进行谈判做准备。谭先生于昨日早晨7点乘火车从南京抵达此处，进行短暂访问。

据谭先生称，南京的司法当局将与外交部合作，为废除领事裁判权做准备。指出由司法部组织的特别委员会将调查并收集数据，这些数据将对外交部在此方面的未来谈判有用。

在评论领事裁判权问题时，谭先生说，在华拥有代表的列强已表现出愿意放弃此类特权。但在1926年联合调查委员会在华进行考察旅行之后，各方达成协议，在上海公共租界组织一个临时法庭作为会审公廨的替代机构，作为一种过渡措施。

在该协定于1930年期满时，根据新的移交协定条款，临时法庭改组为第一特区法院。后一协定原定于1930年3月底期满，但在上海列强代表的请求下，同意再延长三年。

(3) The date, time and place of arbitration for the parties concerned will be set by the arbitrators.
(4) During the period of arbitration, the contending parties, in addition to their appearance at the Court, may reserve the right to engage persons to arbitrate for them.
(5) In case the judgment rendered by the arbitrator is satisfactory to the both parties concerned, the arbitrator will prepare a written statement of the case and remark therein that the 'judgment is agreeable to both parties'.
(6) At the time of arbitration, the Judge present should not give his opinions of the case under dispute, but he is authorized to render final judgment in case the decisions of the arbitrators differ. (8) After the delivery of the arbitration charge by the parties concerned, the written statement of the case will be delivered by the Court.

The parties concerned should agree to the stand by decision of the Court. In case either of the parties fails to observe the provisions of the judgment within three months from the time of delivery, the opposite side may request his Chamber of Commerce to notify the Court of the fact, and the latter will inform the Chamber of the defaulting party to take suitable action.

In connection with the above matter, a reporter of this paper recently called at the Chinese Chamber of Commerce and secured the following information:-

"As nearly 50% of the foreign residents in Shanghai are nationals of countries which have commercial treaties with China, and as the majority of them have no consular jurisdiction, cases of commercial arbitration between Chinese and foreigners, whether the latter are complainants or not, come within the jurisdiction of Chinese courts. In case Chinese are involved in commercial disputes as the offending party, nationals of those countries for which consular jurisdiction is still in force should still apply to the Chinese courts as is stipulated in commercial treaties. There is absolutely no necessity for the establishment of an International Court of Arbitration in Shanghai. However when Chinese are in the position of complainants, they should be allowed to send arbitrators in foreign Chambers of Commerce. Though there is no such definite organization in Shanghai at present, disputes of such nature have been occasionally dealt with by arbitrators, but the decisions rendered carried no weight at law. Therefore this Chamber will strongly protest this suggestion."

有关各方应同意遵守法庭的决定。如果任何一方在交付后三个月内未能遵守判决规定，另一方可请求其商会通知法庭这一事实，后者将通知违约方所属的商会采取适当行动。

就此事项，本报记者近日走访了中国商会，并获得如下信息：

“由于在上海的外国居民中近50%是与中国签有商业条约国家的国民，且其中大多数人没有领事裁判权，因此无论外国人是否为原告，中外之间的商业仲裁案件均属于中国法院的管辖范围。如果中国人作为过错方卷入商业纠纷，那些领事裁判权仍然有效的国家的国民，仍应按照商业条约的规定向中国法院提出申请。完全没有必要在上海设立国际仲裁法庭。然而，当中国人处于原告地位时，应允许他们向外国商会派遣仲裁员。虽然目前上海没有这样的明确组织，但此类性质的纠纷偶尔由仲裁员处理，但其作出的裁决在法律上没有任何效力。因此，本商会将对这一建议提出强烈抗议。”

3. If the measures devised to mediate a case are accepted by both the complainant and defendant, the court will deliver its judgement to them. The judgement will be signed by the President of the Court and the chairman of the two chambers of commerce concerned.
4. The chairman of a chamber of commerce on the one side will only be allowed to attend a mediation meeting when the other side is represented by a chairman of a chamber of commerce.
5. In case mediation fails, the litigants concerned may adopt any other measures to settle the case. The mediating measures devised by this court are not to be used as evidence in a judicial court.
Here follows the regulations governing the arbitration courts:-
1. Any commercial dispute may be brought before this court for arbitration. The applicant for such arbitration should submit a written application clearly stating his name, address, nationality, and circumstances surrounding the case and should forward to the court for investigation all documents relating to the case.
2. On receiving the application, the court, if it deems the case to be within its authority, will notify the defendant to submit within two weeks his defence together with documents relating to the case. The period may be extended provided that there is a sufficient reason. All communications between the court and the litigants will be made through the chambers of commerce of their respective countries.
3. The court may appoint experts to examine any goods in connection with the case.
4. At the beginning of each year the various chambers of commerce will submit a list of arbitrators which they intent to appoint. The arbitrators should represent various phases of commercial activity
5. The litigants may jointly appoint one or two arbitrators and a judge. In case they cannot find suitable arbitrators themselves, the court will appoint one from an impartial chamber.
The following are the regulations governing period and measures relating to arbitration:-
1. The period of arbitration is to be fixed by the court, but it must not exceed 30 days after the definite appointment of the arbitrators.
2. During the progress of arbitration, the court may authorize, at its discretion, the arbitrators to deliberate the circumstances of the dispute and to render suitable and proper judgment of the cases under dispute.

3. 若为调解案件所 devised 的措施被原告和被告双方接受，法院将向他们送达判决书。判决书将由法院院长及相关的两个商会主席签署。

5. 若调解失败，相关诉讼当事人可采取任何其他措施来解决案件。本法院 devised 的调解措施不得在司法法庭上作为证据使用。
以下是管辖仲裁法院的规章：-
1. 任何商业纠纷均可提交本法院进行仲裁。申请仲裁者应提交书面申请，清楚陈述其姓名、地址、国籍及案件相关情况，并应将所有与案件有关的文件送交法院以供调查。
2. 收到申请后，法院若认为案件在其权限范围内，将通知被告在两周内提交答辩状及与案件有关的文件。若有充分理由，该期限可予延长。法院与诉讼当事人之间的所有通讯均将通过其各自国家的商会进行。
3. 法院可指派专家检查与案件有关的任何货物。
4. 每年年初，各商会将提交其拟任命的仲裁员名单。仲裁员应代表商业活动的各个层面。
5. 诉讼当事人可共同任命一至两名仲裁员和一名法官。若他们无法自行找到合适的仲裁员，法院将从一个公正的商会中任命一名。
以下是关于仲裁期限和措施的规章：-
1. 仲裁期限由法院确定，但自仲裁员正式任命之日起不得超过30天。
2. 在仲裁过程中，法院可自行决定授权仲裁员审议纠纷情况，并对争议案件作出适当且恰当的裁决。

May 19, 1935. Morning Translation.

Min Pao and other local newspapers:

CHAMBER OF COMMERCE OPPOSING THE INAUGURATION OF AN
INTERNATIONAL COURT OF COMMERCIAL ARBITRATION.

Recently foreigners in Shanghai proposed to
organize an International Court of Commercial Arbitration.
From enquiries made it is ascertained that Mr. "Kao Huh S"
( ) is the prime mover in the matter. The
organization and the mission of the proposed court has
been published in a certain "Economic Bulletin" and
through this Bulletin the views of the various Chambers
of Commerce have been solicited.
The mission of the Court is to :-
a) conduct mediation.
b) appoint arbitrators to organize an arbitration court.
c) give facilities to arbitrators in commercial disputes.
d) give legal direction to arbitrators.
e) deal with all other affairs relating to commercial cases.
The Court will be organized according to the
following regulations:-
1. The court will be organized by the chambers of commerce
of various countries in Shanghai.
2. The chairman and vice-chairmen of the chambers of
commerce will form an executive committee of the Court.
3. The court will not be affected by the change of the
executive committee members.
4. The affairs of the court will be dealt with by three
standing committee members to be appointed by the
Executive committees.
The term of service of a standing committee member shall
be fixed at one year. The Executive Committee members
will be appointed to serve on the standing committee
by turn.
5. The standing committee members will appoint one of their
number to be chairman. He will concurrently be the
chairman of the Executive Committee and the President
of the Court of Arbitration.
The following is the procedure of mediation to
be conducted by the Courts:-
1. Any commercial dispute of an international character
may be brought before the court for mediation by the
person concerned through his own chamber of commerce.
The applicant should submit to the court for investigation
all documents relating to the case.
2. On receiving an application from a complainant, the
court will ask the defendant through the chamber of
commerce of the latter's country if he is willing to
accept mediation. If so, he should submit to the
court all documents relating to the case. The court
will then invite the chairmen of the two chambers
of commerce concerned to discuss the case with the
standing committee members of the court. When the
mediators hold divergent views, the President of the
court will make a final decision. Complainant and
defendant may be summoned for interrogation if necessary.

1935年5月19日。晨间译件。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

商会反对设立国际商业仲裁法院。

据悉，近期在上海的外国人提议组织一个国际商业仲裁法院。经查询获悉，“Kao Huh S”先生（音译）是此事的主要推动者。拟议中的法院的组织架构和使命已在某份《经济公报》上刊登，并通过该公报征求各商会的意见。
该法院的使命是：-
a) 进行调解。
b) 任命仲裁员以组织仲裁庭。
c) 为商业纠纷中的仲裁员提供便利。
d) 向仲裁员提供法律指导。
e) 处理与商业案件有关的所有其他事务。
该法院将根据以下规章组建：-
1. 该法院将由在上海的各国外商会组建。
2. 各商会的主席和副主席将组成法院的执行委员会。
3. 法院的工作不受执行委员会成员变动的影响。
4. 法院的事务将由执行委员会任命的三名常设委员会成员处理。
常设委员会成员的任期定为一年。执行委员会成员将轮流担任常设委员会成员。
5. 常设委员会成员将从其成员中任命一人为主席。他将兼任执行委员会主席和仲裁法院院长。
以下是由法院进行的调解程序：-
1. 任何具有国际性质的商业纠纷，均可由相关人员通过其所属商会提交法院进行调解。申请人应向法院提交所有与案件有关的文件以供调查。
2. 收到原告的申请后，法院将通过被告所在国的商会询问被告是否愿意接受调解。若是，他应向法院提交所有与案件有关的文件。随后，法院将邀请相关两个商会的主席与法院常设委员会成员讨论此案。当调解人意见分歧时，由法院院长作出最终决定。如有必要，可传唤原告和被告进行讯问。

May 20, 1935.

Shanghai Morning Post (official organ of Gen.Chiang Kai Shek)
and other local newspapers:

CHINA AND EXTRATERRITORIALITY : HER ATTITUDE REGARDING THE
PROPOSED INTERNATIONAL COURT OF ARBITRATION

D.1043

Zing Tseng, Vice-President of the Judicial
Yuan, in an interview with newspapermen yesterday, made
the following statements:-
"In 1919 when the Paris Conference was in
progress, the Chinese Government submitted a demand for
the abolition of extraterritoriality and consular
jurisdiction, but the Conference turned it down. The
Chinese Government repeated her demand at the Washington
Conference in 1921 and the Conference decided to appoint
an Investigation Mission to visit China. The Mission
came to China in 1926.
"It so happened that in that year, General
Chang Chung Chang executed Ling Bah Sz (林白水) (a Chinese
newspaper editor) in Peiping. The Mission seized upon
this incident as a pretext to declare that the Chinese
judicial system was unjust. In 1930, the Chinese
Government succeeded in concluding with Britain, America,
France, Holland, Brazil and Norway an agreement relating
to the Chinese Court in the International Settlement of
Shanghai, by which the Mixed Court and the practice of
having an Assessor sitting at hearings were abolished.
"This agreement expired in 1933 and was
extended for another three years with the approval of
both parties. The second term of the agreement will
expire in March 1936. The Chinese Government has formed
a Judicial Rights Research Committee to study the situation.
At the expiry of the agreement next year, the Chinese
Government will endeavour to bring about the abolition
of extraterritoriality. Should any difficulty arise,
the government will insist on a reasonable and just
revision of the agreement. When the Mixed Court
Rendition Agreement was signed, there came into existence
an Advisory Committee organized by the signatories to
the agreement. It is possible that this Advisory
Committee will discuss a revision of the agreement on
its expiry and the Chinese Government may, if necessary,
dispatch officials to participate in the discussion.
"Of late certain foreign residents in
Shanghai have suggested the formation of an International
Court of Arbitration. It is really an attempt on the
part of a certain section of foreign lawyers in Shanghai
to increase their business. The suggestion has no
legislative or judicial basis. In consequence of this,
the Ministry of Justice has not paid attention to the
matter. Although there is in Paris a Court which
closely resembles the so-called International Court of
Arbitration, it is not recognized by the world. The
French Business Arbitration Court is located opposite
the ordinary Courts. Whenever the Arbitration Court
cannot settle a case, the dispute is referred to the
ordinary Courts. The Judges of this Arbitration Court
are appointed by the government. But conditions are
different in China. There is no possibility of an
International Court of Arbitration in Shanghai ever
materialising.

《上海晨报》（蒋介石将军的官方喉舌）及其他本地报纸：

中国与治外法权：其对拟议中的国际仲裁法院的态度

D.1043

司法院副院长郑天锡昨日在接受记者采访时发表了以下声明：-
“1919年巴黎和会期间，中国政府提出了废除治外法权和领事裁判权的要求，但和会予以拒绝。中国政府在1921年的华盛顿会议上重申了这一要求，会议决定任命一个调查团访华。该团于1926年来华。
“恰在那一年，张宗昌将军在北平处决了林白水（一位中文报纸编辑）。调查团抓住这一事件作为借口，宣称中国司法制度不公。1930年，中国政府成功与英国、美国、法国、荷兰、巴西和挪威达成了一项关于上海公共租界中国法院的协议，据此废除了会审公廨及陪审员出庭听审的做法。
“该协议于1933年到期，并经双方批准延长了三年。协议的第二期将于1936年3月到期。中国政府已成立司法权研究委员会以研究局势。明年协议到期时，中国政府将努力促成废除治外法权。若出现任何困难，政府将坚持对协议进行合理且公正的修订。签署《会审公廨归还协定》时，由协定签署方组建了一个咨询委员会。该咨询委员会可能会在协议到期时讨论修订事宜，如有必要，中国政府可派遣官员参与讨论。
“最近，上海的一些外籍居民建议成立一个国际仲裁法院。这实际上是上海部分外籍律师试图增加其业务量的举动。该建议没有立法或司法依据。因此，司法部未对此事予以关注。虽然巴黎有一个与所谓国际仲裁法院非常相似的法院，但它并未得到世界的认可。法国商业仲裁法院位于普通法院对面。每当仲裁法院无法解决案件时，纠纷便移交至普通法院。该仲裁法院的法官由政府任命。但中国的情况不同。上海的国际仲裁法院绝无可能成为现实。”

May 21, 1935. Morning Translation.

Min Pao (official organ of the Kuomintang)
and other local newspapers.

AN INTERNATIONAL COURT OF COMMERCIAL ARBITRATION

D.1043.

Sung Tsu Kyi (孫祖基), an attorney-at-law, made the statement yesterday criticising the proposed formation of an International Court of Commercial Arbitration by certain unprincipled foreigners in Shanghai:-
(高侯恩) "A German lawyer named 'Kao-Er-En' recently suggested the formation of an International Court of Commercial Arbitration in Shanghai. Articles relating to the principles and objects of this Court have appeared in the local foreign press. The opinions of leading Chinese commercial organs were solicited. It requires no effort to believe that 'Kao' has some ulterior motive in putting forward this ridiculous suggestion. The establishment of such a Court in Shanghai will impair the judicial rights of China.
"In the opinion of 'Kao', this Court will deal only with arbitration or mediation over commercial matters, but it is quite obvious that the formation of such an International Court of Arbitration in Shanghai will greatly affect the working of the local Chinese Courts. In view of the fact that the regulations governing this International Court stipulate that the contending parties must pay a reasonable amount of the expenses incurred by the arbitrator and that the contending parties may, at their discretion, invite other persons to act for them during the arbitration, and that suitable action will be taken in case of non-compliance with the decision of the arbitrators, the procedure of this Court closely resembles that followed in the ordinary Courts.
"In view of the above, 'Kao's' suggestion for the formation of an International Court of Arbitration is in reality a suggestion for the establishment of a 'Mixed Court of Arbitration'. Coming at a time when the Mixed Courts in the International Settlement and the French Concession have already been abolished and consular jurisdiction is about to be abolished, such a suggestion is ridiculous. I am strongly opposed to this suggestion."

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

INCREASE IN THE PRICE OF PORK.

Pigs for consumption in this locality are usually procured from Wusih, Changchow and other districts. The price is about $16 per one hundred catties. To-day, the price has risen 100%.
The daily consumption of pork in Shanghai is between 3,000 to 4,000 heads. Formerly, about 6,000 pigs used to be sent here daily and so the price was kept low. At the present time, only about 1,000 pigs are sent here daily, thereby creating a big demand.

《民报》（国民党机关报）及其他本地报纸。

国际商事仲裁法庭

D.1043。

律师孫祖基昨日发表声明，批评上海某些无原则外侨提议设立国际商事仲裁法庭一事：-
(高侯恩) “一位名为‘Kao-Er-En’的德国律师最近建议在上海设立国际商事仲裁法庭。有关该法庭原则和宗旨的文章已见于本地外文报刊。并征询了中国主要商业机构的意见。不难相信，‘高’提出这一荒谬建议别有用心。在上海设立此类法庭将损害中国的司法权。
“在‘高’看来，该法庭仅处理商事事项的仲裁或调解，但显而易见，在上海设立此类国际仲裁法庭将极大影响当地中国法院的运作。鉴于管辖该国际法庭的规章规定，争议双方必须支付仲裁员产生的合理费用，且争议双方可自行决定邀请他人代理仲裁事宜，并对不遵守仲裁裁决的情况采取适当措施，该法庭的程序与普通法院遵循的程序极为相似。
“鉴于上述情况，‘高’关于设立国际仲裁法庭的建议，实际上是建议设立‘混合仲裁法庭’。在国际租界和法租界的混合法院已被废除、领事裁判权即将废除之际，提出此类建议实属荒谬。我强烈反对这一建议。”

猪肉价格上涨。

本地消费的生猪通常购自无锡、常州等地。价格约为每百斤16元。今日，价格已上涨100%。
上海每日猪肉消费量在3,000至4,000头之间。以往，每日运抵此地的生猪约6,000头，故价格保持低位。目前，每日运抵此地的生猪仅约1,000头，从而导致需求大增。

May 28, 1935. Morning Translation.

"The judicial rights of China are impaired
so long as consular jurisdiction is in existence.
Recently a Chinese girl was raped by a foreigner employed
in a circus but as his country enjoys consular jurisdiction
the case could not be dealt with by the Chinese courts
but had to be referred to the Consul-General of the
nation to which the culprit belonged.
"Yet foreigners are still not satisfied
with the privileges accorded them by the unequal treaties,
and are planning to organize an International Court
of Commercial Arbitration."

Yesterday the Federation of Shanghai College
Students issued the following circular telegram :-
According to the principles of International
Law, any person, irrespective of nationality, who lives
in the territory of a nation, is subject to the law
of the country in which he is living. The establishment
of a Consulate is for the purpose of facilitating control
over the commercial affairs of the nationals of that
Consulate living in another country. Consular
Jurisdiction is the right of a Consul to assume
jurisdiction over his national when he is involved in
a civil or criminal case in the country where he is
residing. Consular Jurisdiction does not exist in a
country which is independent. Japan and Turkey have
abolished Consular Jurisdiction.
After the May 30 Incident, the feeling of
the Chinese people against Imperialists became serious
and the abolition of Consular Jurisdiction was demanded.
But no result could be obtained because the foreigners
hold the view that China's judicial administration is
incompetent.
The term of the Rendition Agreement of the
Shanghai First Special District Court will expire at the
end of March next year. If China desires to abolish
this agreement, she must notify the countries concerned
six months prior to the expiration of the agreement.
The National Government has established a Judicial
Rights Research Committee to handle the problem.
The conclusion of the Rendition Agreement
was based on Consular Jurisdiction. Therefore, the
abolition of the agreement will mean the abolition of a
part of Consular Jurisdiction. The basic measure to
complete China's judicial administration is to abolish
Consular Jurisdiction.
The judicial system of China has now been
improved. Russian and German residents in China are
enjoying the protection of Chinese Law, the treatment
they receive is the same as that received by the Chinese
people. It is to be hoped that all friendly nations
will abandon the unequal treaties and conclude new
treaties respecting the sovereignty of both parties.
The National Government should enforce a revolutionary
diplomacy, while the people throughout the country should
swear to support the Government.

（批：D.1042 / Cantier）

1935年5月28日。上午译件。

“只要领事裁判权存在，中国的司法权就受到损害。
最近一名在马戏团工作的外国人强奸了一名中国女孩，但由于其国籍国享有领事裁判权，该案无法由中国法院审理，而必须移交罪犯所属国的总领事处理。
“然而，外侨仍不满足于不平等条约赋予他们的特权，并正策划组织国际商事仲裁法庭。”

昨日，上海学生联合会发出如下通电：-
根据国际法原则，任何人，无论国籍如何，只要居住在一国领土内，即受该国法律管辖。设立领事馆的目的是为了便于控制居住在他国的该国国民的商业事务。领事裁判权是指领事对其国民在居住国卷入民事或刑事案件时行使管辖权的权利。独立国家不存在领事裁判权。日本和土耳其已废除领事裁判权。
五卅惨案后，中国人民反帝情绪高涨，要求废除领事裁判权。但因外人认为中国司法行政无能，故未获结果。
上海第一特区法院《移管协定》将于明年3月底到期。若中国希望废除该协定，必须在协定到期前六个月通知有关国家。国民政府已成立司法权研究委员会来处理此问题。
《移管协定》的缔结基于领事裁判权。因此，废除该协定意味着废除部分领事裁判权。完善中国司法行政的根本措施是废除领事裁判权。
中国司法制度现已得到改善。在华俄籍和德籍居民享有中国法律保护，所受待遇与中国人民相同。希望所有友好国家放弃不平等条约，缔结尊重双方主权的新条约。
国民政府应推行革命外交，而全国民众应宣誓支持政府。

（批：D.1042 / Cantier）

May 28, 1935. Morning Translation.

Central China Daily News (official organ of Wang Ching
Wei) and other local newspapers :-

THE SUGGESTED INTERNATIONAL COURT OF COMMERCIAL
ARBITRATION

The Chinese Chamber of Commerce has already
expressed its opposition to the suggestion of certain
local foreign residents to form an International Court
of Commercial Arbitration, while the Chinese Bar
Association has decided to issue a manifesto condemning
the proposal.
Lawyer Ma Chun Zah (馬君碩), member of the
Executive Committee of the Chinese Bar Association,
interviewed by a reporter, said :-
"The manifesto is under preparation and will
be published very soon. In my opinion, there is no
possibility of such a court coming into existence,
especially at this time when the Powers are elevating
their Legations in China to Embassies and are endeavouring
to promote their relations with China. The Rendition
Agreement of the Shanghai Special District Court is
about to expire and the Chinese people should pay
attention to this question."
Tai Chi Sien (戴維先), Secretary to the
Chinese Bar Association, made the following statement to
a reporter :-
"The foreigners in Shanghai have always
opposed the Chinese Courts. Formerly the Mixed Court
in the Settlement was under the control of the foreigners.
In 1927 the Mixed Court was reorganized and became known
as the Provisional Court. Later, this Court was replaced
by the present Special District Court and foreign Consuls
have ceased to sit in Court but the S.M.C. still controls
the gaol and retains the right of making appointments
to the judicial police. But following the formation
of the Provisional Court, the influence of foreigners has
diminished. In consequence, propaganda detrimental
to Chinese Courts has made its appearance from time to
time.
"In 1929, Mr. MacDonald, a member of the
S.M.C., in the course of an address at the Ratepayers
Meeting, denounced the Chinese Court, and Mr. Green, editor
of the North China Daily News, wrote an article to the
same effect. But the Consular Body understood the
political situation in China and did not create any
obstruction when the Provisional Court was reorganized
into the present Special District Court.
"The Chinese people should pay close attention
to the proposed formation of an International Court of
Commercial Arbitration and should create a strong
opposition as it is possible that the foreigners may
succeed in attaining their aim.

《中华日报》（汪精卫机关报）及其他本地报纸：-

拟设国际商事仲裁法庭

上海总商会已对部分本地外侨提议设立国际商事仲裁法庭表示反对，而上海律师公会决定发表宣言谴责该提议。
上海律师公会执行委员馬君碩律师在接受记者采访时说：-
“宣言正在起草中，将很快发表。在我看来，此类法庭不可能成立，尤其是在列强正将其驻华公使馆升格为大使馆并努力促进对华关系的当下。上海特区法院《移管协定》即将到期，中国人应关注此问题。”
上海律师公会秘书戴維先向记者发表如下声明：-
“上海外侨一直反对中国法院。此前，租界内的混合法院受外人控制。1927年，混合法院改组，称为临时法院。后来，该法院被现在的特区法院取代，外国领事不再出庭坐堂，但工部局仍控制监狱并保留任命司法警察的权利。但随着临时法院的成立，外人的影响力已减弱。因此，损害中国法院声誉的宣传不时出现。
“1929年，工部局董事MacDonald先生在纳税人大会上发表演讲时抨击中国法院，《字林西报》编辑Green先生也写了类似文章。但领事团了解中国政治局势，在临时法院改组为现在的特区法院时未制造任何障碍。
“中国人民应密切关注拟设国际商事仲裁法庭一事，并应形成强大反对力量，因为外人有可能实现其目标。

June 12, 1955. Afternoon Translation.

Tang Seng (Party Voice 党声), Vol. 1, Issue 19, dated June 8 publishes the following article :-

THE INTERNATIONAL COURT OF ARBITRATION.

Some time ago the "Economic Commercial Press" published a ridiculous suggestion made by a German lawyer regarding the organization of an International Court of Arbitration in Shanghai. The main points of his argument for the formation of this body are that the court is to be composed of the various foreign Chambers of Commerce in Shanghai and that the court is to handle commercial disputes of an international nature.

The Shanghai First Special District Court in the International Settlement, according to the Rendition Agreement, is different from the Courts in other places and its existence constitutes a violation of China's judicial rights. Fortunately, the date of the expiry of the Court agreement is approaching.

The suggestion of the German lawyer is nothing but a subterfuge to maintain the illegal Consular Jurisdiction.

About 80% of the law-suits between foreigners and Chinese are of a commercial character, because foreign merchants are in the habit of doing everything in their power to cheat and exploit Chinese by virtue of the unequal treaties. The formation of a Court of Arbitration will only cause foreigners to go beyond the law.

We must protest against the proposed formation of such a Court. In the meantime, we hope broad-minded foreigners will uphold justice and not be misled by such a ridiculous suggestion.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers :-

THE DEATH OF A SEAMAN OF A FOREIGN SHIP

In connection with the mysterious death of Hoo Pao Sung (何宝生), a member of the crew of a foreign ship named "Lai Kuh Sie Mao" (来吉西毛), the wife of the deceased has appealed for relief to the China Seamen's Union. Too Kuh Zai (屠法才) and three other members of the crew of the steamer have been interrogated by the Seamen's Union. However, nothing suspicious about them was discovered, and they were released on security provided by the Tien Ying (天盈) Seamen's Union and a reliable shop. Since then further rumours against these four seamen have arisen. Upon learning of this, the families of these seamen and other members of the crew of the same steamer have sent a joint petition to the Tien Ying Seamen's Union.

Yesterday morning over 400 members of these families called at the local Tangpu and other political organs in seven motor trucks and submitted a petition stating that the four seamen were again being falsely accused and requesting the authorities to make an investigation.

1955年6月12日。下午译文。

《党声》第一卷第十九期，六月八日出版，刊登如下文章：-

国际仲裁法庭。

日前，《经济商报》刊登了一名德国律师提出的关于在上海设立国际仲裁法庭的荒谬建议。他主张成立该机构的主要论点是，该法庭应由在沪各外国商会组成，并负责处理具有国际性质的商业纠纷。

根据《法院移交协定》，公共租界内的上海第一特区地方法院与其他地方的法院不同，其存在构成了对中国司法权的侵犯。幸而，该法院协定的到期日已临近。

这名德国律师的建议不过是维持非法领事裁判权的诡计。

中外之间的诉讼约有80%属于商业性质，因为外商习惯于凭借不平等条约，竭尽全力欺骗和剥削中国人。设立仲裁法庭只会导致外国人更加凌驾于法律之上。

我们必须抗议拟议中的此类法庭的成立。同时，我们希望心胸开阔的外国人能主持正义，不被这种荒谬的建议所误导。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：-

外籍轮船海员之死

关于名为“来吉西毛”号外籍轮船船员何宝生（Hoo Pao Sung）的神秘死亡事件，死者妻子已向中国海员工会求助救济。屠法才（Too Kuh Zai）及该轮另外三名船员已接受海员工会的讯问。然而，未发现他们有任何可疑之处，他们在由天盈海员工会和一家可靠商号提供担保后获释。此后，针对这四名海员的进一步谣言又起。得知此事后，这些海员的家属及同轮其他船员联合向天盈海员工会递交请愿书。

昨日上午，这些家属中的400余人分乘七辆汽车前往当地塘沽及其他政治机关，提交请愿书，称这四名海员再次遭到诬陷，并要求当局进行调查。

July 5, 1935.

THE ABOLITION OF CONSULAR JURISDICTION

The term of the Rendition Agreement
of the Shanghai First Special District Court expired
in 1933 but was later extended for three years with
the consent of the National Government. The agreement
will expire in March, 1936.
As the expiration of the agreement is
fast approaching and the National Government is
determined not to conclude a further agreement, the
Government has already issued a declaration announcing
the abolition of the Consular Jurisdiction after the
expiration of the agreement.
Reports have been published in local
newspapers to the effect that a certain section of
foreign residents is proposing to form an International
Arbitration Court to deal with cases concerning foreign
residents in Shanghai.
According to information secured by a
reporter of this paper from judicial circles, this
proposal reflects the desire of a part of the foreign
residents for the continuance of Consular Jurisdiction.
The proposal is detrimental to the judicial administration
of China. China will energetically oppose the
establishment of such a court.

Shanghai General Labour Union Suggests the Despatch of

Chu Hsuan Fan, Chairman of the Shanghai General

December 17, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

Chen Pao (Shanghai Morning Post) and other local newspapers:

SPECIAL DISTRICT COURT RENDITION AGREEMENT TO EXPIRE

The rendition agreement of the Special District Court in the International Settlement, which has been extended for another three years, will expire in March 1936. The judicial and diplomatic authorities are carefully considering measures for a revision of this rendition agreement, while people of the law circles will also make a thorough research into the subject.

Enquiries made by our reporter from the parties concerned show that as this rendition agreement is of only a temporary nature, both parties have the option of (should it at any time after the signing of the agreement be found to be unsuitable) having the terms of the said agreement rediscussed, before the expiry of the agreement, with a view to making a revision in the terms.. The two parties discussed the agreement in February 1933, and although this agreement was not cancelled nor revised, a paragraph of announcement was inserted into the notes of exchange appended, to answer the necessities of the circumstances. This paragraph says:- "The Chinese Authorities are now suggesting the adoption of measures to guard against the excessive delay in civil procedure especially in cases of appeal and the enforcement of decisions". It is learned that the Chinese judicial and diplomatic authorities are of the opinion that there is of no necessity for the continued extension of this rendition agreement as the contents of the agreement contain unsuitable parts. Full preparations must be made in studying a revision of the agreement for purpose of vigilance and the opinions of judicial experts are being solicited towards the matter.

Our reporter made enquiries from local law circles and learned that people of the circles are paying special attention to a revision of the Special District Court rendition agreement which is to expire in the near future. They expect the Government to undertake a revision of this agreement on a most satisfactory scheme. As an assistance to the Government they are also soliciting views among themselves and studying the question of the revision of the agreement so that they may present their views from the legal standpoint to the Government, for reference purpose when the agreement is to be revised.

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

特区法院移交协定即将期满

公共租界内特区法院的移交协定已再延期三年，将于1936年3月期满。司法和外交当局正在仔细考虑修订此移交协定的措施，法律界人士也将对此问题进行深入研究。

本报记者向有关方面查询获悉，由于此移交协定仅具临时性质，双方均有权（若在签订协定后的任何时候发现协定不合适）在协定期满前重新讨论上述协定的条款，以便对条款进行修订。双方曾于1933年2月讨论过该协定，虽然该协定未被取消或修订，但在附带的换文中插入了一段公告，以应对当时情况的需要。该段文字称：“中国当局现建议采取措施，以防止民事诉讼程序，特别是上诉和执行判决方面的过度拖延”。据悉，中国司法和外交当局认为，由于协定内容包含不适当的部分，没有必要继续延长此移交协定。必须为研究修订协定做好充分准备，以保持警惕，并就此事项征求司法专家的意见。

本报记者向本地法律界人士查询获悉，各界人士正特别关注即将到期的特区法院移交协定的修订问题。他们期望政府以最令人满意的方案修订此协定。作为对政府的协助，他们也在内部征求意见，研究协定修订问题，以便在修订协定时从法律角度向政府提出意见，供参考。

February 21, 1936. Morning translation.

THE RENDITION AGREEMENTS

At the general meeting of the National
Bar Federation yesterday, the Shanghai Bar Association
and the Unjest Prosecution Compensation Committee
suggested that the supreme judicial authorities should,
in co-operation with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs,
devise immediate measures for the abolition of, or
improvement in, the Rendition Agreements of the two
foriign Settlements of Shanghai which will soon expire
so as to facilitate the centralization of judicial
control and uphold China's sovereign rights.

At present, the organization,
administration and the judicial procedure followed by
the Chinese Courts established within the foreign
Settlements of Shanghai by virtue of the Rendition
Agreements are totally different from those of the Chinese
Courts in other parts of China. This is due to the
existence of these agreements.

The term of the two agreements will
soon expire and it is hoped that the supreme judicial
authorities, in co-operation with the Ministry of Foreign
Affairs, will open negotiations with the various powers
concerned for the abolition or an amendment of the
agreements as has been suggested by the Report of the
Judicial Inquiry Commission of Various Nations.

《移交协定》

在昨日召开的中华全国律师协会全体会议上，上海律师公会和“Unjest Prosecution Compensation Committee”（音译）建议最高司法机关应与外交部合作，制定立即废除或改进即将到期的上海两外国租界《移交协定》的措施，以便集中司法管辖权并维护中国的主权权利。

目前，依据《移交协定》在上海外国租界内设立的中国法院，其组织架构、行政管理及司法程序与中国其他地区的中国法院截然不同。这是由于这些协定的存在所致。

这两项协定的期限即将届满，希望最高司法机关能与外交部合作，按照各国司法调查委员会报告所建议的那样，与有关列强开启谈判，以废除或修订这些协定。

THE COURT RENDITION AGREEMENT

February 18, 1937. Afternoon Translation.

Min Pao publishes the following article written by one Chen
Zai Qun (程瑞鈗) :-

THE EVIL EFFECTS OF CONSULAR JURISDICTION

Consular jurisdiction means that cases in
which foreigners are involved are not subject to the
jurisdiction of the authorities of the country in which
they are residing.
The existence of consular jurisdiction in China
is partly due to the ignorance and corrupt administration of
the Manchu Government, but principally to coercion and
oppression by the foreign Powers under the pretext that the
judicial system of China at that time was corrupt and not up
to date.
Since the establishment of the National Government
at Nanking, many improvements have been introduced into the
judicial system of this country and it is now not far behind
that existing in other civilized nations. But why is
consular jurisdiction still in force in this country?
As consular jurisdiction is an already
secured privilege, the foreign Powers will never willingly
relinquish it. Its existence not only jeopardizes our
administrative rights and impairs our judicial system
but encourages ronins to commit unlawful activities such
as smuggling and inducing traitorous Chinese to change
their nationality. We should endeavour to bring about
the abolition of consular jurisdiction. As the existence
of consular jurisdiction is based upon the unequal treaties,
we must first work for the abolition of all these treaties.

1937年2月18日。午后译件。

《民报》刊登程瑞鈗（Chen Zai Qun）撰写的以下文章：-

《领事裁判权的恶果》

领事裁判权意味着涉及外国人的案件不受其居住国当局的管辖。
领事裁判权在中国的存在，部分是由于满清政府的愚昧和腐败行政，但主要是由于列强以当时中国司法制度腐败且落后为借口进行的胁迫和压迫。
自南京国民政府成立以来，本国司法制度已引入许多改进，目前已不落后于其他文明国家的现行制度。但为何领事裁判权仍在本国有效？
由于领事裁判权是一项既得特权，列强绝不愿自愿放弃。它的存在不仅危及我们的行政权利并损害我们的司法制度，还纵容浪人从事走私和诱使叛国华人改变国籍等非法活动。我们应努力促成领事裁判权的废除。由于领事裁判权的存在基于不平等条约，我们必须首先致力于废除所有这些条约。

March 9, 1937. Afternoon Translation.

The Society Evening News publishes the following comment on
March 8 :-

THE ABOLITION OF CONSULAR JURISDICTION

In the course of a speech, a certain
spokesman of the Japanese Gaimusho expressed his sympathy
toward China's movement for the abolition of consular
jurisdiction but he concluded by saying that China must
first regulate her judicial system before she can start
negotiations with the Foreign Powers for the abolition of
consular jurisdiction and that she should not be in such
a hurry as to give rise to unfavourable repercussions.
These words show that Japan, though
sympathetic towards China's desire for the abrogation of
consular jurisdiction, is not prepared for negotiations
with China over this matter until China has regulated her
judicial system.
The consular jurisdiction which Japan
enjoys in China is extremely advantageous to her, so it
is impossible to hope that she will ever give up this
privilege. To tell the truth, it is already quite an act
of friendship for Japan to have expressed such sympathetic
words towards China's desire for the abolition of consular
jurisdiction. For our part, we persist with our fixed
foreign policy even should Japan be unwilling to agree
to the abolition of consular jurisdiction.

Shanghai Mercantile Press ( 上海商報 ) (comment) :-

THE INSPECTION OF FACTORIES

The principal object of the inspection
of factories is to ascertain whether or not the employers

《社会晚报》于3月8日发表以下评论：-

《废除领事裁判权》

日本外务省某发言人在一次演讲中表示同情中国废除领事裁判权的运动，但他最后称，中国必须先整顿其司法制度，然后才能与列强开始谈判废除领事裁判权，且不应过于匆忙以免引起不利反响。
这些话表明，日本虽然同情中国废除领事裁判权的愿望，但在中国整顿好其司法制度之前，并不准备就此事项与中国进行谈判。
日本在中国享有的领事裁判权对其极为有利，因此不可能指望她会放弃这一特权。说实话，日本就中国废除领事裁判权的愿望表达如此同情的言辞，已算是相当友好的举动了。就我方而言，即使日本不同意废除领事裁判权，我们仍坚持既定的外交政策。

《上海商报》（评论）：-

《工厂检查》

工厂检查的主要目的是查明雇主和雇员是否遵守《工厂法》。
1929年11月《工厂法》颁布时，工厂主因其过于严格而表示反对。随后《工厂法》进行了修订。人们认为，进行检查时会发生麻烦。
应向雇主和雇员解释为何有必要进行检查，以避免误解。

"On the principle of diplomatic equality,
the National Government should negotiate energetically
with the various foreign nations for the abolition of
consular jurisdiction. Whereas several friendly nations
have already voluntarily given up this right, many of the
Foreign Powers, recognized to be the first class nations
of the world and known to have close relations with China,
are unwilling to give up this privilege. This is due either
to the influence upon them of the prejudiced and selfish
ideas of their nationals or to an aggressive desire to
make use of this antiquated system as a means of infringing
the sovereign rights of China.
"Although several of these Powers have
concluded treaties with China, containing appendices
providing for the abolition of consular jurisdiction, yet
a study of all these appendices reveals the same thing:
i.e. they will be willing to give up this privilege on
condition that all the other nations, enjoying the same
privilege, agree to its abolition. From this, we can see
how difficult it is to get a date for the automatic
abolition of consular jurisdiction. As far as we can see,
these Powers are only taking advantage of this condition
in order to refuse the abolition of the privilege.
"Under such circumstance, unless China
makes most strenuous efforts, she will never be able to
attain her object in her negotiations; on the contrary
the sufferings that she has been subjected to during the
past several decades will never come to an end and will
become more and more severe. That China, although she
fully realizes the danger of this anomalous position, does
not proclaim independently the abolition of consular
jurisdiction, is because of the restrictions of the treaties
and of the fact that she considers it wrong to start the
movement without the agreement of the other parties. However,
so far as we know, it is not an uncommon practice, (as a
matter of fact, it is provided for in International Law
that exceptions can be allowed to meet a change in inter-
national conditions) for one treaty nation to proclaim
independently the abolition of the treaty or treaties which
she has concluded with another nation. During the past
ten years, many of the Powers have themselves abolished
treaties, which are a hundred times more important, without
getting the approval of the other interested parties, as
witness the non-repayment of the loans advanced by the
United States during the World War to Great Britain, France
Italy and Belgium. Other instances are the failure on
the part of Germany to pay her war indemnities to the
Allied Nations and worst of all, the failure on the part
of the member states of the League of Nations to apply
sanctions, as provided by the League Convention, against
Japan in her invasion of our Four North-Eastern Provinces
on September 18, 1931, and against Italy in her aggression
against Ethiopia in 1935.
"Compared with such violations, the
abolition of the treaties that provide for consular
jurisdiction for the Foreign Powers is of small importance.
Therefore, it is not unreasonable for China to cite the
precedent created by the various Foreign Powers as a reason

“基于外交平等之原则，
国民政府应与各外国积极谈判，
以废除领事裁判权。鉴于若干友好国家
已自愿放弃此项权利，许多被公认为世界
一等强国且与中国关系密切的外国列强，
却不愿放弃此特权。这要么是因为其国民
偏狭自私观念的影响，要么是出于利用这一
陈旧制度作为侵犯中国主权手段的侵略性欲望。
“虽然这些列强中已有数国与中国
缔结了条约，其中附件规定废除领事裁判权，
但研究所有这些附件 reveals 同样的情况：
即它们愿意在其他享有同等特权的国家均同意
废除的前提下，才放弃此特权。由此可以看出，
确定自动废除领事裁判权的日期是何等困难。
据我们看来，这些列强只是利用这一条件
来拒绝废除该特权。
“在此情况下，除非中国
做出最大努力，否则在谈判中永远无法
达到其目标；相反，过去几十年来所遭受
的苦难将永无终结之日，且会日益严重。中国
虽然充分认识到这种异常地位的危险，却未
独立宣布废除领事裁判权，这是因为受到条约
的限制，以及认为在未获其他当事方同意的情况下
发起此举是不妥的。然而，
据我们所知，一国独立宣布废除其与另一国
所缔结的条约并非罕见做法，（事实上，国际法
规定允许例外情况以适应国际形势的变化）
在过去十年中，许多列强自身已废除了
重要百倍的条约，而未获得其他相关当事方的批准，
例如美国在世界大战期间向英国、法国、
意大利和比利时提供的贷款未予偿还。其他例子包括

国际联盟成员国未能按照《国联盟约》的规定，

以及对意大利于1935年侵略埃塞俄比亚实施制裁。
“与上述违约行为相比，
废除规定外国列强享有领事裁判权的条约
显得微不足道。因此，中国援引各外国列强
所创之先例作为理由，并非不合理

March 23, 1937. 2 Afternoon Translation.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :-

AUTOMATIC ABOLITION OF CONSULAR JURISDICTION SUGGESTED

China began to conclude commercial treaties with various Foreign Powers during reigns of Emperors Yen Feng (咸豐) and Dong Shih (同治) of the now defunct Ching Dynasty. At that time, owing to ignorance on the part of the Chinese officials of international relations, the various treaty nations were given the right to enjoy consular jurisdiction. For this reason, the precedent was established and it has done much harm to the Chinese nation during the past several decades.

Ever since it came into power, the National Government has worked very hard for the abolition of consular jurisdiction. Various reforms have been introduced in the Chinese judicial system and Courts have been established in many districts, while the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has been instructed to accelerate its negotiations over this subject with the various Foreign Powers. As a result, the consular jurisdiction enjoyed by Poland, Greece, Mexico, Czecho-Slovakia and Turkey was abolished through the commercial treaties concluded between China and these countries in the 18th and the 19th Years of the Chinese Republic.

However, due to the insincere attitude of the various other Powers, who are unwilling to give up this privilege despite repeated negotiations, the abolition of this antiquated system has been postponed indefinitely. The existence of consular jurisdiction not only jeopardizes our judicial rights but also greatly affects the future prosperity of China.

Seeing that the abolition of consular jurisdiction is a task that should not be further postponed, Mr. Loh Ting Kwei (陸鼎揆) and various other local lawyers have proposed to the Shanghai Bar Association that the National Government be petitioned to cite the precedent created by Great Britain, France, Belgium and other nations in not paying their war debts to the U.S.A. as a reason for proclaiming China's intolerance of consular jurisdiction and for fixing a date for the automatic abolition of this antiquated system.

The following is an abridged translation of the text of the proposal:-

"The existence of consular jurisdiction not only impairs the sovereign rights, but hampers the unification of the judicial system of China. Moreover, it makes it practically impossible for Chinese to get legal redress in their dealings with those foreign nationals who enjoy consular jurisdiction, to say nothing of the serious repercussions it has upon financial, economic, military and commercial affairs as well as on the maintenance of peace and order in China, as witness the huge territory that we have lost during the past several decades. It is impossible to relate all the suffering and damage that have been caused during the past several decades by this antiquated system.

1937年3月23日。 2 下午译文。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：-

建议自动废除领事裁判权

中国在已灭亡的清朝咸丰（Yen Feng）和同治（Dong Shih）皇帝在位期间，开始与各外国列强缔结商约。当时，由于中国官员对国际关系无知，各缔约国被授予享有领事裁判权的权利。因此，这一先例得以确立，并在过去几十年中对中华民族造成了极大危害。

国民政府执政以来，为废除领事裁判权付出了巨大努力。中国司法制度进行了各项改革，在许多地区设立了法院，同时外交部奉命加速与各外国列强就此问题进行谈判。结果，波兰、希腊、墨西哥、捷克斯洛伐克和土耳其享有的领事裁判权，通过中华民国十八年和十九年中国与这些国家缔结的商约得以废除。

然而，由于其他列强态度不诚，尽管经过反复谈判仍不愿放弃此特权，导致这一陈旧制度的废除被无限期推迟。领事裁判权的存在不仅危及我们的司法权利，也严重影响中国未来的繁荣。

鉴于废除领事裁判权是一项不应再拖延的任务，陆鼎揆（Loh Ting Kwei）律师及其他本地律师向上海律师公会提出建议，请求 petition 国民政府，援引英国、法国、比利时等国不偿还对美国战债的先例，作为理由，宣布中国不能容忍领事裁判权，并确定自动废除这一陈旧制度的日期。

以下是提案文本的节译：-

“领事裁判权的存在不仅损害主权，而且阻碍中国司法体系的统一。此外，这使得中国人在与享有领事裁判权的外国人打交道时，实际上无法获得法律救济，更不用说它对中国的金融、经济、军事和商业事务以及和平秩序的维护所产生的严重反响，正如我们在过去几十年中丧失的大片领土所见证的那样。过去几十年中，这一陈旧制度造成的苦难和损害不胜枚举。

Afternoon Translation.

Sz Tan Pao (時代報) publishes the following comment :-

ABOLITION OF CONSULAR JURISDICTION

A few days ago, Mr. Loh Ting Kwei (陸鼎揆),
a lawyer, submitted a proposal to the Chinese Bar
Association, requesting it to petition the National
Government to fix a date for the abolition of Consular
Jurisdiction. We are of the opinion that the people
throughout the country should be aroused to support this
proposal, and by taking further steps, we may bring about
a thorough abolition of all the unequal treaties. In
this way, the bonds placed on China by the Imperialists
for the last 90 years can be severed.
In view of the fact that they will not be
able to maintain all the unequal treaties or their so-
called special rights once Consular Jurisdiction is
abolished, the Powers will naturally oppose the independent
action of the Chinese Government in proclaiming abolition.
Such opposition is expected, but we should not withdraw
when it comes. It will not be difficult to quell the
objections of the Powers if the Chinese Government and
its people keep to a strong determination.
Although we agree to the automatic
declaration by the Chinese Government of the abolition
of Consular Jurisdiction, yet negotiations through usual
diplomatic channels should not be given up. In the past,
negotiations through diplomatic channels have met with
failure. However in future, the Chinese Government
should open independent negotiations with various Powers
for the actual abolition of Consular Jurisdiction without
conditions appended.

废除领事裁判权

日前，律师陆鼎揆（Loh Ting Kwei）向中国律师公会提交了一份提案，请求其 petition 国民政府确定废除领事裁判权的日期。我们认为，应唤起全国民众支持这一提案，并通过采取进一步措施，我们可以实现彻底废除所有不平等条约。这样，帝国主义者在过去90年间加诸于中国的枷锁便可被斩断。

March 27, 1937. Morning Translation.

Shun Pao published the following editorial comment on March 26:-

ABOLITION OF CONSULAR JURISDICTION

The system of Consular Jurisdiction has in itself many defects. First, the difference in the application of laws. The consular jurisdiction depends on the nationality of the defendant, and as the laws of various countries are not the same, an act which is considered an offence by one Consulate is not so regarded by another. In consequence, many cases of a like nature bring different decisions.

Secondly, take the non-jurisdiction of a Consular Authority over witnesses and plaintiff of a different nationality. If thd witnesses necessary for a case are cf a nationality different to that of the defendant, the latter's consular authority cannot compel them to appear to give evidence nor can it charge them with perjury if they are willing to attend but give false evidence.

Thirdly, the difficulty in gathering evidence in the case of a foreigner committing an offence in the interior of China. When a foreigner commits an offence while in the interior, he should be handed over to his nearest consular authorities to be dealt with; he can be arrested but not ill-treated. By this stipulation, a foreigner who commits an offence against public morals or who commits an offence of intentional manslaughter while journeying in the interior of China, must be handed over to his consular authorities in a trading port thousands of miles away. In a place which lacks easy communication, it would take a long time to hand over an offender to his consular authorities, and it would be a difficult task to gather evidence at the time of hearing.

Fourthly, the difference between the office of a Consul and that of a Judge. The office of a Consul is to protect the interests of his citizens. It is almost an impossibility to expect a fair judgment from him when he is required to try a case in which one of his citizens is charged by a citizen of another nation.

In view of the foregoing four defects, the system of Consular Jurisdiction should have been abolished long ago.

The existence of Consular Jurisdiction is a serious encroachment on China's sovereign rights and is liable to afford undesirable foreign nationals a shield to carry out their subversive activities in our territory. For example, the rampant smuggling and trafficking in noxious drugs as well as the existence of a great number of special military bodies. Consular Jurisdiction is at the root of these evils.

We must support our government in its efforts to bring about the abolition of Consular Jurisdiction.

1937年3月27日。晨间译件。

《申报》于3月26日发表如下社论：-

废除领事裁判权

领事裁判权制度本身存在诸多缺陷。首先，法律适用上的差异。领事裁判权取决于被告的国籍，而各国法律不尽相同，某一领事馆视为犯罪的行为，另一领事馆却未必如此认定。因此，许多性质相似的案件往往得出不同的判决。

其次，领事当局对异国籍证人及原告无管辖权。如果案件所需的证人与被告国籍不同，被告所属的领事当局既不能强制其出庭作证，若其愿意出庭但提供伪证，也不能以伪证罪起诉他们。

第三，外国人在中国内地犯罪时取证困难。当外国人在内地犯罪时，应将其移交至最近的领事当局处理；可以逮捕，但不得虐待。根据这一规定，在中国内地旅行期间犯有妨害风化罪或故意杀人罪的外国人，必须移交给数千英里外通商口岸的其本国领事当局。在交通不便的地方，将罪犯移交给其领事当局需要很长时间，且在审理时收集证据也是一项艰巨的任务。

第四，领事职务与法官职务之间的差异。领事的职责是保护其本国公民的利益。当要求他审理一起其本国公民被另一国公民指控的案件时，几乎不可能期望他做出公正的判决。

鉴于上述四个缺陷，领事裁判权制度本应早已废除。

领事裁判权的存在严重侵犯中国的主权权利，并容易为不良外籍人士提供庇护，使其在我国领土内进行颠覆活动。例如，猖獗的走私和毒品贩运，以及大量特殊军事团体的存在。领事裁判权是这些弊端的根源。

我们必须支持政府为废除领事裁判权所做的努力。

Morning Translation.
Lih Pao publishes the following letter received from one Huang
Jun Nan ( 黄 君 南 ):-
The Rendition of Foreign Settlements and the Abolition of
Consular Jurisdiction
I send the following views for submission
for publication in your paper as regards the early rendition
of the foreign settlements and the automatic abolition of
consular jurisdiction:-
We will never attain our object of the
rendition of the foreign settlements and the abolition of
consular jurisdiction simply by means of "hope" or by "mere
talk of the adoption of drastic measures". Even if the
powers were willing to hand over the control of the foreign
settlements and to voluntarily abolish consular jurisdiction,
we should still not gain any actual benefits.
Unless the people of the nation are
determined to sacrifice their lives or at least be prepared
for such sacrifice, there is no possibility of our attaining
our object in connection with these two questions.
Furthermore, we should not forget that there are other
areas which are tens of thousands of times as large as
the foreign settlements and which we have not yet recovered.
According to a Tokyo telegram dated
March 25, Japan has arrogantly declared that she is opposed
to the abolition of the concessions and the consular
jurisdiction. The telegram further states that Japan is
determined not to allow the permanent peace in the Far
East to be menaced by acts of recklessness, and that she
will convey this idea to the Chinese government in order
to urge it to come to its senses. Is not this a severe
setback to our desire?
Before we adopt effective measures
to deal with these questions, we must carefully study (1)
our present position internationally, (2) the cause of
the existence of the foreign settlements and consular
jurisdiction, (3) the historical facts and (4) the effect
of the existence of these two antiquated systems on the
living conditions of the Chinese people.
Furthermore, the idea expressed by
Mr. Loh Yin Wei ( 陸 尹 偉 ) and other local lawyers in
their proposal for an independent abolition of consular
jurisdiction, in which they quote that the powers have
disregarded the provisions of the agreements they have
concluded with other nations......might easily give
rise to misunderstanding, because we must know that the
reason for China's demand for the abolition of consular
jurisdiction is not to jeopardize others, as the powers do,
but to struggle for her own freedom.

《立报》刊登了收到的一封来自黄君南 ( Huang Jun Nan ) 的信件：-
交还租界与废除领事裁判权
兹呈上以下观点，供贵报刊登，内容涉及尽早交还外国租界及自动废除领事裁判权：-
我们绝不可能仅凭“希望”或“空谈采取严厉措施”来实现交还外国租界和废除领事裁判权的目标。即使列强愿意移交外国租界的控制权并自愿废除领事裁判权，我们仍然无法获得任何实际利益。
除非全国民众决心牺牲生命，或至少做好此类牺牲的准备，否则我们在解决这两个问题上绝无可能实现目标。
此外，我们不应忘记，还有比外国租界大数万倍的其他地区尚未收回。
据3月25日东京电讯，日本傲慢地宣布反对废除租界和领事裁判权。该电文进一步称，日本决不允许鲁莽行为威胁远东的永久和平，并将向中国政府传达这一想法，促使其清醒过来。这对我们的愿望难道不是一个严重的打击吗？
在采取有效措施处理这些问题之前，我们必须仔细研究 (1) 我们目前的国际地位，(2) 外国租界和领事裁判权存在的原因，(3) 历史事实，以及 (4) 这两个陈旧制度的存在对中国人民生活状况的影响。
此外，陆尹伟 ( Loh Yin Wei ) 先生及其他本地律师在其关于独立废除领事裁判权的提案中表达的观点，引用了列强无视其与其他国家签订的协定条款......这很容易引起误解，因为我们必须知道，中国要求废除领事裁判权的原因并非像列强那样危害他人，而是为了争取自身的自由。

April 5, 1937. Afternoon Translation.

Sunday Times ( 星期报 ) published the following comment on April 4 :-

THE ABOLITION OF CONSULAR JURISDICTION

Consular Jurisdiction is a weapon used by the Imperialists to interfere with China's judicial rights. If a Chinese desires to take legal action against a foreigner, he has to do so in the Consular Court concerned. The Consular Court always sides with its national and frequently dismisses the cases Chinese have thus suffered considerably in economic disputes with foreigners. On the one hand, Consular Jurisdiction infringes the sovereign rights of China and oppresses the Chinese people, and on the other, protects the illegal actions of foreign nationals.

The National Government has long ago suggested to foreign governments the abolition of Consular Jurisdiction. The abolition has so far not been carried out due to the insincere attitude of the various Powers. The Chinese diplomatic authorities are also responsible for this on account of their failure to put forward their utmost efforts.

At present, Chinese laws and regulations are perfect and improvements have been introduced in Chinese Courts and gaols. Chinese Judges, before appointed, have to pass examinations and undergo training. Furthermore, the organization of the Chinese Government is daily getting sounder. This is why the Consular Jurisdiction that impairs China's sovereign rights should be abolished without delay.

After his appointment as Foreign Minister, Dr. Wang Chung-hui suggested the abolition of all unequal treaties and Consular Jurisdiction. He is held in esteem by the people, and the abolition of Consular Jurisdiction depends upon his efforts and the encouragement of the people.

To look at the Chinese Courts in the foreign Settlements, it would appear that many judicial rights have been recovered by China. In reality, the organization of the Courts in the foreign Settlements is most unsound. The right to appoint judicial police is vested with the Settlement Police, and Procurators are powerless. The Settlement Police have a monopoly in the rights of investigation and prosecution. Very often, the Settlement Police do not charge an accused in a criminal case due to their misunderstanding of it and in this way, the complainant cannot find a remedy. Following the expiry of the Court Rendition Agreement, the Chinese Government failed to suggest an amendment, but agreed to an extension of the agreement. If the Government had been brave enough to open negotiations with the Powers concerned, the organization of the Special District Courts would have become much more sound and the authority of the Procurators would have become greater.

The abolition of Consular Jurisdiction is demanded by all the people throughout the country and the Government should be determined to bring it about.

1937年4月5日。午后译件。

《星期报》 ( Sunday Times ) 于4月4日发表如下评论：-

废除领事裁判权

领事裁判权是帝国主义者干涉中国司法权的武器。如果中国人想对外国人采取法律行动，必须在相关的领事法庭进行。领事法庭总是偏袒其本国国民，经常驳回案件，中国人在与外国人的经济纠纷中因此遭受了巨大损失。一方面，领事裁判权侵犯中国的主权权利并压迫中国人民，另一方面，它保护外籍人士的非法行为。

国民政府早已向外国政府建议废除领事裁判权。由于各列强态度不诚恳，废除工作至今未能实施。中国外交当局也因未能竭尽全力而对此负有责任。

目前，中国的法律法规完善，中国法院和监狱也已得到改善。中国法官在任命前必须通过考试并接受培训。此外，中国政府的组织日益健全。这就是为什么损害中国主权权利的领事裁判权应立即废除。

王宠惠 ( Wang Chung-hui ) 博士就任外交部长后，建议废除所有不平等条约和领事裁判权。他深受人民敬重，废除领事裁判权取决于他的努力和人民的鼓励。

观察外国租界内的中国法院，似乎中国已收回了许多司法权。实际上，外国租界内法院的组织极不健全。任命司法警察的权利掌握在租界巡捕房手中，检察官无权无势。租界巡捕房垄断了侦查和起诉权。很多时候，租界巡捕房因误解而不刑事起诉被告，导致控告人无法获得救济。在《法院移交协定》期满后，中国政府未能提出修正案，而是同意延长该协定。如果政府有足够的勇气与有关列强展开谈判，特区法院的组织将会更加健全，检察官的权威也会更大。

废除领事裁判权是全国人民的共同要求，政府应下定决心予以实现。

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

ABOLITION OF CONSULAR JURISDICTION

In connection with the question of the abolition
of consular jurisdiction, the Shanghai Bar Association some-
time ago sent a petition to the National Government and the
Executive Yuan requesting them to notify the various Powers
concerned for the abolition of this system.
Yesterday the Association sent the following
circular letter to the various Bar Associations throughout
the country and other public bodies :-
"Not only does the prevalence of consular
jurisdiction jeopardize the sanctity of our judicial rights,
but also endangers our national existence and property.
Despite our repeated proclamations for the abolition of this
antiquated system, no result has as yet been achieved.
"China has now become united and she is on her
way towards prosperity and rejuvenation. If this system is
allowed to exist, it will constitute a great handicap to the
revival of the Chinese nation. For this reason, this
Association petitioned the National Government and the
Executive Yuan to notify officially the various foreign
Powers concerned of the date for the abolition of consular
jurisdiction and to proclaim the independent abolition of
this system in case the Powers enjoying this privilege fail
to comply with our demand after the expiration of the time
limit.
"As this question closely affects the
emancipation of the entire Chinese nation, we hope that
your honourable associations and public bodies will pledge
your unanimous support to our suggestion for the abolition
of this system."

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

ABOLITION OF CONSULAR JURISDICTION

One hundred and seventy local trade association, including the Silk Dealers' Association, the Cotton Cloth Dealers' Association, the Paper Dealers' Association, the Foreign Medicine Dealers' Association, the Woollen Goods Dealers' Association, the Timber Dealers' Association and the Medicine Manufacturers' Association, yesterday sent the following telegraphic petition to Dr. Wang Chung-hui, Minister of Foreign Affairs:-

"At the end of the Ching Dynasty, foreign invasion followed one upon the other and as a result of the Tientsin Treaty, foreigners were granted consular jurisdiction in China. At that time Chinese and foreign customs differed from each other and the foreign countries demanded consular jurisdiction on the pretext of protecting their nationals in China.

"Since the enforcement of this system, many mal-practices have arisen. During the past several years our members have suffered much injustice for which they have had no means of redress. Our attention is drawn to this question every time we read in Dr. Sun Yat Sen's will of the abolishing of unequal treaties.

"China has now been unified and law and politics have been stabilized. It is without doubt that the peace-loving Chinese people will treat all foreign nationals equally. All those countries who treat us with equality should respect China's rights and voluntarily give up their consular jurisdiction. If they fail to do so, China should declare consular jurisdiction abolished; her act would be in conformity with world justice.

"We request you to bring about the abolition of consular jurisdiction as soon as possible."

Min Pao (comment) :-

The consular jurisdiction enjoyed by the various Foreign Powers in China is one of the most unequal judicial privileges in the world. The fact that, despite our continued desire for the abolition of this antiquated system, no result has so far been attained convinces us of the truth of the saying that a weak nation has no diplomacy.

It may be recalled that at the Third Plenary Session held recently by the National Government, a decision that negotiations be opened for the abolition of consular jurisdiction was reached. Furthermore, it will be remembered that during his term of office as Foreign Minister, Dr. C.T. Wang did open separate negotiations with Great Britain, the U.S.A., France, Japan and various other Powers in connection with this question. We should not allow the continued existence of this antiquated system that constitutes a serious menace to our national rejuvenation and revival especially in view of the fact that China has now become united. The views expressed in the telegraphic petition jointly sent by local public bodies can be taken as a representation of the general opinion of the entire Chinese nation. It is sincerely to be hoped that Dr. Wang Chung-hui, the Foreign Minister, will bring about the realization of our desire for the abolition of consular jurisdiction.

The Shanghai Kwangtung Pao (上海廣報) published the following
comment on April 10 :-

LEGAL ASPECT OF CONSULAR JURISDICTION

For many years, consular jurisdiction
has been detrimental to China. A nation-wide appeal for
the independent abolition of this system has been made
many times and on numerous occasions our Government has
consulted on the matter with the various Powers concerned
but without any result.
After Dr. Wang Chung-hui took over
the Foreign Affairs Ministry, people throughout the country
again urged that decided action be taken to abolish
independently this system which is endangering the people
as well as the State. We believe that the new Foreign
Minister will regard as his first important duty the
settlement of this question.
From a legal point of view, the
existence of consular jurisdiction in China is a violation
of International Law and Treaties. China should be able
at any time voluntarily to declare the system null and void.
According to International Law, the sovereign rights of a
country include all controlling rights, both administrative
and judicial, within its own territory. This sovereignty
can only be exercised in a nation's own territory and not
in that of other nations. The existence of consular
jurisdiction in China is really an infringement of the law,
because it places foreign nationals in China beyond the
control of Chinese Law, thus impairing Chinese sovereignty.
The Powers who enjoy this privilege have extended their
sovereign rights into Chinese territory; this state of
affairs is contrary to International Law.
The system of consular jurisdiction was
put into effect in China in the year 1858 after the
conclusion of the Anglo-Chinese and Franco-Chinese Treaties
at Tientsin. As conditions in China have totally changed
and Sino-Foreign relations are also different from before,
these treaties should not remain in force. Furthermore,
the League of Nations and the Nine-Power Peace Pact have
definitely specified the recognition by various Powers of
the integrity and independence of Chinese sovereignty and
territory. This stipulation obviously signifies that China
is an independent country as defined in International Law.
As a rule, after the formation of new agreements, the old
ones which conflict with the new lose their effectiveness.
Under the League of Nations and the Nine-Power Peace Pact,
the Tientsin Treaties should become void and consular
jurisdiction should have no more legal basis. Consular
jurisdiction is illegal and China has the right naturally
to abolish it automatically at any time.

《上海广报》于4月10日发表如下评论：-

领事裁判权的法律层面

多年来，领事裁判权一直对中国有害。全国范围内多次呼吁独立废除这一制度，我国政府也曾就此事与各有关列强进行磋商，但均无结果。
自王宠惠博士接任外交部长以来，全国各地再次敦促采取果断行动，独立废除这一危及人民及国家的制度。我们相信，新任外交部长会将解决此问题视为其首要重要职责。
从法律角度来看，领事裁判权在中国的存在违反了国际法和条约。中国应能随时自愿宣布该制度无效。根据国际法，一个国家的主权包括在其领土内的所有行政和司法控制权。这种主权只能在本国领土内行使，而不能在其他国家领土内行使。领事裁判权在中国的存在实际上是对法律的侵犯，因为它使在华外国人不受中国法律的约束，从而损害了中国的主权。享有此特权的列强将其主权权利延伸到了中国领土；这种状况违背了国际法。
领事裁判权制度是在1858年《中英天津条约》和《中法天津条约》签订后在中国实施的。由于中国的状况已发生彻底变化，中外关系也与以往不同，这些条约不应继续有效。此外，国际联盟和《九国公约》明确规定了各列强对中国主权和领土完整及独立的承认。这一规定显然意味着，按照国际法的定义，中国是一个独立国家。通常，在新协定形成后，与之冲突的旧协定即失去效力。在国际联盟和《九国公约》之下，《天津条约》应归于无效，领事裁判权也不应再有任何法律依据。领事裁判权是非法的，中国自然有权随时自动予以废除。

Shanghai Public Daily News (Comment) :-

OPPOSITION TO INCREASE IN MUNICIPAL RATE

The Chinese Ratepayers' Association in the International Settlement, at its meeting of representatives held on April 12, passed the following resolution concerning the proposal of the S.M.C. to increase the Municipal Rate and the Land Tax as from July 1, 1937:-

"That the subject re the proposal of the S.M.C. to increase the rates as from July 1, 1937 be postponed until 1938 for further discussion; that the S.M.C. be ordered to exercise economy in all expenses this year and to press for payment of unpaid rates."

For several years, the S.M.C. has been suggesting an increase in the rates and Mr. Arnhold, Chairman of the Council, is always the most vigorous in supporting the suggestion. Regarding the retrenchment measures of the Council and the proposed increase in the rates, the Chinese members gave their opinions after having made a close study of the matter, but they were rejected by Mr. Arnhold. It seems that Mr. Arnhold, a representative of the Council, does not fear boycotts or strikes. Why did the retiring Council hold its last meeting on April 7 though only eight councillors were present, while one Japanese and five Chinese councillors were absent?

At last, on April 8, a sense of what was right overcame the Council and Mr. Arnhold's confidence in the casting vote deserted him. It was decided that the results of a meeting attended by only eight persons should have a final approval before they were considered effective. As the proposal for the increase in the Municipal Rate, which was primarily considered as one of the utmost importance, had already been published and the increased Rate had already been included in the Estimates, no attempt was made to hush up the matter and Mr. King was asked to propose an amendment to the original proposal. While the attitude of Mr. Arnhold has been too strong, the unhesitating manner in which he righted his mistake conformed with the teaching of our sage, Confucius, "Do not be afraid to rectify your mistakes," and deserves our praise. From this we learn that rightful opinions or actions, such as were expressed or taken by the Chinese councillors in the present case, will bring people to their senses in the end.

Up to the present, the Council and the rate-payers have always been guided by common sense. Neither the Council nor the ratepayers should harbour the mistaken idea that eight and a half months is a long time. Instead, the Council should in this short period of time enforce economy and collect all rates in arrears. We want the S.M.C. to carry out the following:-
(1) Do away with exchange compensation. If this is not possible, let us ask: What happened to the War debts owing to the U.S.A.?

反对增加市政捐

国际租界华人纳税人协会在4月12日举行的代表会议上，针对工部局提议自1937年7月1日起增加市政捐和地税一事，通过了以下决议：-

“关于工部局提议自1937年7月1日起增加捐税的事项，推迟至1938年进一步讨论；责令工部局在今年各项开支中实行节约，并催缴未付捐税。”

多年来，工部局一直建议增加捐税，而工部局总董Arnhold先生总是最有力地支持这一建议。关于工部局的紧缩措施和拟议的增捐，华籍成员在仔细研究后提出了意见，但被Arnhold先生驳回。看来，作为工部局代表的Arnhold先生并不害怕抵制或罢工。为何卸任工部局在4月7日举行最后一次会议时，仅有八名董事出席，而一名日籍董事和五名华籍董事缺席？

最终，在4月8日，正义感战胜了工部局，Arnhold先生对决定性一票的信心动摇了。会议决定，仅由八人参加的会议结果需获得最终批准方可生效。由于主要被视为极其重要的增加市政捐提案已经公布，且增加的捐税已列入预算案，因此并未试图掩盖此事，而是请King先生对原提案提出修正案。虽然Arnhold先生的态度过于强硬，但他毫不犹豫地纠正错误的做法符合我们圣人孔子“过则勿惮改”的教诲，值得称赞。由此我们得知，像本案中华籍董事所表达或采取的正确意见或行动，终将使人们清醒过来。

迄今为止，工部局和纳税人一直由常识引导。工部局和纳税人都不应抱有八个半月是很长时间的错误想法。相反，工部局应在这段短时间内实行节约并收缴所有欠缴捐税。我们要工部局执行以下事项：-
(1) 取消汇兑补偿。如果这不可行，我们要问：欠美国的战争债务怎么了？

April 14, 1937.

The Great Crystal (大晶報) published the following
on April 13 :-

ABOLITION OF CONSULAR JURISDICTION

Lately, the various local public bodies
submitted a joint petition to Dr. Wang Chung-hui, Minister
of Foreign Affairs, asking him to exercise strenuous
efforts for the abolition of consular jurisdiction, so
that our national prestige can be upheld and the unifica-
tion of our judicial rights maintained. This request is
indeed very important and deserves public support from
whatever point of view.
The foreign Powers began to enjoy this
privilege in China after the conclusion of the Anglo-
Chinese Treaty in Nanking more than 90 years ago. Since
then, not only has this antiquated system caused much
havoc and loss among the Chinese people, but it has also
rendered our judicial authorities powerless to deal justly
with lawsuits that involve foreign subjects in China
enjoying this privilege. To tell the truth, the existence
of this system not only jeopardizes our national rights,
but also impairs to a great extent the legal rights and
interests of the Chinese people. Cases of injustice to
which Chinese people have been subjected owing to the
prevalence of consular jurisdiction are so numerous that
there is no need for us to quote any one of them here.
What we hope is that our diplomatic authorities will make
strenuous efforts to bring about the abolition of this
unequal system. We also hope that our fellow countrymen
throughout the country will start an extensive movement
for the abolition of consular jurisdiction.

The Diamonds (金剛鑽) published the following article on
April 13 :-

RUSSIAN PICKPOCKETS IN CINEMAS

Owing to the fact that the patrons of the
large local cinema theatres are mostly quite well-to-do,
the number of pickpockets attending is unquestionably
growing, and the most numerous are the white Russian
emigrants in Shanghai. They usually attend cinema theatres
about ten minutes prior to the commencement of the
performances and generally at first showings when the
audiences are large. Once they are inside the cinema
houses, the first thing they do is to ascertain whether
or not there is any possibility for their underhand
activities. They usually sit by the side of those who
are well dressed. As soon as the lights are out, they
begin their activities and when they have picked a pocket,
they go to the lavatory and properly conceal the stolen
property before they come out leisurely from the theatres.
It is learned that there are no less than
100 such Russian pickpockets frequenting local cinema
theatres.

《大晶报》于4月13日刊登如下内容：-

废除领事裁判权

近日，各地公共团体联合向外交部长王宠惠博士呈递请愿书，恳请其大力推动废除领事裁判权，以维护国家尊严并保持司法主权的统一。此项请求无论从何种角度审视，均极为重要，值得公众支持。
列强自九十余年前《南京条约》签订后，开始在中国享有此特权。自此，这一陈旧制度不仅给中国人民造成巨大破坏和损失，还致使我国司法机关在面对享有此特权的在华外籍人士涉及的诉讼时，无法公正处理。实话实说，该制度的存在不仅危及我国国权，也在很大程度上损害了中国人的法律权益。因领事裁判权盛行而致使中国人遭受的不公案例数不胜数，此处无需赘举其一。我们所期望的是，我国外交当局能大力促成这一不平等制度的废除。我们也希望全国同胞发起广泛的废除领事裁判权运动。

《金剛鑽》于4月13日刊登如下文章：-

电影院里的俄国扒手

由于本地大型电影院的观众大多相当富裕，光顾的扒手数量无疑正在增加，其中最多的是在上海的白俄移民。他们通常在演出开始前约十分钟进入电影院，且一般选择观众较多的首场放映时段。一旦进入影院，他们首先要确定是否有进行暗中活动的可能。他们通常坐在衣着光鲜者身旁。灯光一灭，他们便开始活动，得手后便前往洗手间妥善藏匿赃物，然后从容离开剧院。据悉，经常光顾本地电影院的此类俄国扒手不下100人。

also highly prejudicial to the maintenance of peace and
order as well as financial, military and commercial
conditions. The harm that such unequal treaties have done
to us is enormous. For this reason, the abolition of all
such unequal treaties in the interests of the independence
and existence of the Chinese nation is a matter of utmost

It will not be difficult for us to
open negotiations for the abolition of extraterritoriality
in so far as the various Powers are concerned, with the
exception of Japan which constitutes the strongest obstacle
to our negotiations. However, on the other hand, it is

With a view to bringing about the

Sin Wan Pao Evening Edition published the following editorial
on April 14 :-

While various circles in China are
advocating the independent abolition of consular jurisdiction,
the international conference being held at Montreaux to
discuss the abolition of consular jurisdiction in Egypt
attracts our particular attention and shows us more clearly
than ever that no country can tolerate the existence of this
system.
The Powers have promised to recognize
Egypt as an independent state; therefore the demand of Egypt
to abolish consular jurisdiction is quite natural and deserves
our sympathy. In the case of China, there is even more reason
for the abolition of consular jurisdiction, for China has
always been an independent state.
One point which is still being contested
by representatives of the Powers and Egypt is whether there
should be a transitional period in the abolition of the system.
Whatever the result may be, no transitional period is required
in China. The judicial administration of China is steadily
approaching perfection and fair treatment and lawful protection
are given to foreign residents. No further test is therefore
needed and the unfair system should be abolished forthwith.
Leaving aside the legal aspect of the
us
question, let consider what good it does the Powers to
preserve consular jurisdiction. It only serves as a tool
in the hands of ambitious nations. It affords protection
to foreign ronins who are thus enabled to commit all kinds of
discreditable acts. Not only are the judicial and sovereign
rights of China impaired, but all friendly nations are
adversely affected by the system, as for example when irregular
acts are carried out in commercial ports or when peace and
order are disturbed. If the Powers enjoying consular
jurisdiction in China will get rid of their unjust ideas and
consider the matter carefully, they will realize that they
should support China's demand for abolition of the system
instead of opposing it.

也严重妨害和平与秩序的维持，以及金融、军事和商业状况。此类不平等条约给我们造成的危害巨大。因此，为了中华民族的独立与生存，废除所有此类不平等条约是至关重要且紧迫的事项，不容再拖延。
就各国而言，除了日本构成我们谈判的最大障碍外，我们就废除治外法权开启谈判并非难事。然而，另一方面，促使日本废除其在华享有的领事裁判权，较之于其他列强，更为紧迫和必要。
为了实现中华民族的解放，我们全体国民必须全心全意支持政府为达成废除这一不平等制度所做的努力。

《新闻报》晚刊于4月14日发表如下社论：-

当中国各界倡导单方面废除领事裁判权之际，正在蒙特勒举行、讨论废除埃及领事裁判权的国际会议引起了我们的特别关注，并比以往更清楚地表明，任何国家都无法容忍该制度的存在。
列强已承诺承认埃及为独立国家；因此，埃及要求废除领事裁判权是完全自然的，值得我们要同情。就中国而言，废除领事裁判权的理由更加充分，因为中国一直是一个独立国家。
列强代表与埃及方面仍在争论的一点是，废除该制度是否应有一个过渡期。无论结果如何，中国不需要任何过渡期。中国的司法行政正稳步走向完善，外籍居民得到了公平对待和法律保护。因此无需进一步测试，应立即废除这一不公平的制度。
撇开该问题的法律层面不谈，让我们考虑一下保留领事裁判权对列强有何好处。它仅充当野心勃勃的国家手中的工具。它为外国浪人提供庇护，使其得以实施各种有损名誉的行为。这不仅损害了中国的司法和主权权利，所有友好国家也因该制度受到不利影响，例如在不规则行为在通商口岸发生或和平秩序受到扰乱时。如果在中国享有领事裁判权的列强摒弃其不公正的观念并仔细考量此事，他们将意识到应当支持中国废除该制度的要求，而不是反对它。

CONSULAR JURISDICTION ABOLITION RESEARCH ASSOCIATION TO

With regard to the question of the
abolition of consular jurisdiction, the Chinese Chamber
of Commerce and 173 local trade associations have petitioned
the Government to effect abolition as soon as possible.
The leaders of the various public bodies have held an
informal meeting making preparations for the formation
of a Consular Jurisdiction Abolition Research Association
in support of the Government. In case the Powers concerned
refuse, it is determined to abolish consular jurisdiction
independently.

The Central China Daily News (Editorial) :-

Ever since it was brought up for
discussion at the Third Plenary Session, the question of
abolition of consular jurisdiction enjoyed by the various
foreign Powers in China has been receiving nation-wide
attention. The desire for the abolition of this system
has become greater because of the rampant smuggling
activities in Shanghai and the arbitrary protection of
smugglers by the Consular authorities of a certain nation.
It may be recalled that the Government has been petitioned
by over 170 local public bodies as well as the Shanghai
Chinese Chamber of Commerce to accelerate its negotiations
for the abolition of this unequal jurisdiction. Similar
demands have also been made to the National Government
by the Tientsin Bar Association for the early abolition
of consular jurisdiction with a view to upholding the
integrity of our judicial rights.
Undoubtedly, consular jurisdiction is
an integral part of the unequal treaties that are being
used by the Powers as a means to oppress China. The
sufferings and oppression that we have been subjected to
during the past 90 years owing to the existence of these
unequal treaties are so numerous that they cannot be
described here. Our "friendly neighbour", especially, is
taking advantage of the existence of these unequal treaties
to conduct activities endangering the safety of our country
and jeopardizing the integrity of our sovereign rights,
as a means to accelerate the extinction of China. Take,
for instance, the activities of the Consulates of this
certain nation in various parts of China, which are taking
advantage of the existence of the consular jurisdiction
which they enjoy as a means to aid and abet smuggling,
rendering our Government powerless to adopt positive measures
for the suppression of smuggling or for the punishment of
the smugglers. The ronins of this nation are taking
advantage of their enjoyment of consular jurisdiction to
undertake all kinds of unlawful activities to the detriment
of the peace and order of this country, either from an
economic or military point of view. Not only is the
existence of such unequal treaties detrimental to the
